solution.what: Telegrams transcribed from the JACAR PDFs; doubtful letters re-read by Brice Dudout in blind panels.

Chinese text punctuated and translated; doubtful codes marked.

validation.notes: Chinese plaintext through the telegraph code: the letter n-gram test cannot run on Chinese characters; the readings were checked by sense

outcome.fraction_read_source: 97 of 97 codes give a character (doubtful codes counted as read; see decryption.txt).

texts.label: “Seventeenth” table: 4 telegram(s), 17 April 1916 - 20 April 1916
texts.summary: Shanghai → “Rosamonde”, April 1916; clear indicator “Seventeenth”. Condenser of the Swatow family: consonants rotated, vowel order i u a e o. Table recovered in October 2026.

reading_review.note: 4 telegrams, 28 of 97 codes doubtful; 0601a and 0608a build sense (Shaanxi should wait; send funds), but 0591 and 0593 are mostly doubtful fragments ({鄂}{乳}{廹}; {姣}{宋}{瓀}{襾}{借}{碼}) and the translation of both is largely gaps.
